tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything that is not footage.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the newsletter field, menus. Sits on paper and is separated by a line hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, input borders and the rules between timeline lanes.

tokens.name: lane
tokens.usage: Empty track behind clips in the Multitrack. Never used for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and clips in the Multitrack, on paper, paper-raised and lane.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timecodes and captions under media, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent: the playhead, the active clip, primary buttons, links, markup strokes and focus. As text, on paper and paper-raised only.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind signal text: the active lane chip and hovered rows.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill, such as the primary button label.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The ground for footage: video frames, reels, scroll-scrubbed sequences. Always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-stage
tokens.usage: Captions, titles and timecode laid over stage.

tokens.name: on-stage-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary HUD text on stage, such as the take number or frame count.

tokens.name: stage-signal
tokens.usage: The playhead, active clip and progress bar when they sit on stage. signal itself is too dark on stage in the light theme.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Only the recording dot that marks something live (the agent, a stream). Never a fill, never text longer than LIVE.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of signal so a theme that moves signal moves links.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Instrument Sans at 600 with tight tracking. One display line per screen.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The homepage thesis only. Drops to 56px under 600px wide.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Project names on their own page, section openers.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Running text stays near 65 characters wide.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I design it, engineer it, wire it, film it and score it.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a display line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: It waits on hold, says it is an AI, and books the table.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: It said it was an AI. They booked the table anyway.
styles.usage: Captions burned over footage, in on-stage. Sentence case, never all caps.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for anything a machine would print: numbers, timecodes, labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and metadata, set uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Durations, frame counts, live clocks. Use tabular numbers.

groups.name: Accent
groups.note: Instrument Serif italic, shared with the reels. At most one word or phrase per screen.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: Inline inside a display line for the single human word, at the display line's size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gaps inside a meta row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between lanes in the Multitrack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a display line and its lede.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-clip
tokens.usage: Clips in the Multitrack, lane chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Media frames and cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the signup field.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Only a media frame under the cursor. Nothing rests on a shadow.
